items.picture: A busy morning at Tomáš's company: on every floor of the building people are at work, in offices, in a meeting, at a training session and in the canteen. At the entrance, Tomáš waves to the receptionist.
The technical department of Tomáš's company: Tomáš and two colleagues work at their screens while an IT technician carries a new computer through the room.
An after-work party at Tomáš's company: employees, men and women, chat in small groups round a table of snacks and drinks; Tomáš talks with a woman colleague in a blazer.
A team meeting at Tomáš's company: Tomáš and four colleagues sit round a table with their manager, talking things over.
A business lunch: Tomáš and a client in a suit sit across a restaurant table from each other, talking over their plates.
At her dorm desk, Emma scrolls through job ads on her laptop and circles one in a printed list, a mug of tea beside her.
Emma's CV lies finished on her desk, one page with a small photo of her in the corner; she signs it with a flourish.
A job interview in a small office at Tomáš's company: Emma, in a smart blazer, sits upright across the desk from the HR manager, who reads her CV through her glasses.

items.text: Emma wants to work at a company for three months during her studies. What is she looking for?

items.picture: A sunny Saturday: Emma, Lucia and Tomáš hike up a forest path in the hills above Bratislava with backpacks, Lucia leading the way.
Summer: Emma and Lucia cycle along a path through green rolling hills under a hot sun.
Winter: the same rolling hills under deep snow; Emma and Lucia, in woolly hats and scarves, trudge along the path.

items.text: Kedy máte čas na pohovor? What is the HR manager asking?
Emma's CV says: “Študovala som v Dubline.” What does it mean?
